title: AltCraft
description: AltCraft is a mod that is Minecraft completely reimagined.
body:
![AltCraft Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bdef0c46816694f9d93f0994087485fce76eabb9_0.webp)

# !! WE ARE CHANGING MODLOADERS AND VERSIONS

We are going to switch the loader to Fabric, and the version to 26.1.2 for more stability and speed! Sorry!

# Anyways

The mod that adds what the community wants in a mojang-like way.

For example:

- Vertical slabs
- Guns
- Stacking slabs
- And more.

Also, AltCraft adds things that I feel would be a cool feature.

The features get tons of testing, and have a support area in the [AltCraft website](https://moonii.org/altcraft.net) for bug reports, feature suggestions, and more.

# Changelog

1.00 - Guns n' Crystals

- Items: Added Twilight, Twilight Ore, Twilight Sword, Twilight Axe, Twilight Pickaxe, Twilight Shovel,  Lightning Shard, Gun, 9mm Ammo, and Bullet.
- Potion: Added American, and Twilight Power.
- Structure: Added Sand ruins, and Twilight burial.
- Workstation/Job: Added Gunsmith/Gunsmith Table.
- GUI: Added Keybind Overlay, and Dynamic Crosshair.
